description: Task-routing manifest; not an OpenCode CLI configuration file

implementation.scope: One bounded Kotlin/Java migration task; propose a patch against explicitly supplied files

lastTask.task: Compose mail threads, member screen, navigation and tests

maintenance.scope: Small mechanical changes, documentation, test fixture preparation

lastProbe.error: Transport: The socket connection was closed unexpectedly.

review.scope: Independent review of complex lifecycle, account isolation, storage or send changes; report concrete defects only

coordinator.scope: Choose task, supply minimal context, review proposals, integrate code and run focused checks

rules: Use exact allowlisted free model IDs; unavailable models stop the task without a paid fallback
Use an isolated working directory and explicit file attachments; do not supply credentials or real mailbox data
No automatic permission approval, live services, APK builds, publication or commits
One invocation per task; investigate a failure before retrying
Request concise findings or a patch; do not forward the full conversation or repository
Coordinator validates model output before applying changes
